public_sources.bound_semantics: Double progressive widening gradually expands MCTS branching; a new state or action is added only while the number of children is within a k*N^alpha threshold, where N is visit count.

A public MCTS treatment describes progressive widening as artificially limiting a node's children to k*N^alpha so large/continuous action spaces do not produce only shallow trees; additional children become available as visits accumulate.

chat_native_reduction.mapping: Use accepted same-scope terminal-readback count N as the only evidence counter and cap active assignment candidates at max(1,floor(sqrt(N))). New proposals beyond the cap remain in immutable FIFO arrival order until N increases the cap.
chat_native_reduction.queue_rule: FIFO is deliberately evidence-neutral; no hypothetical candidate utility is consumed before activation/evaluation.
chat_native_reduction.source_scope: The public sources justify sublinear visit-count-based branch expansion. The exact sqrt floor rule, FIFO queue, durable restart state and terminal-evidence definition are role-local controls.
